values.question: On rows nothing had seen, where does the chosen model err at the rule, and do its scores match the observed rates?
values.segment_rule: The first two categorical features the model uses, in the order of the case; at most 12 values each, the rarer ones folded into "(other values)".

curve.definition: For the top share of the rows by score: recall is the share of the positive rows found (the cumulative gain, and the true positive rate of the ROC curve); lift is the precision over the base rate; the false positive rate is the share of the negative rows selected.

calibration.binning: 10 equal-count bins of the score, in score order
calibration.definition: The Brier score is the mean squared difference between the score and the outcome (0 or 1); the constant base rate gives the reference. A bin whose mean score lies outside the interval of its observed rate is miscalibrated.

segments.small_cell_rule: fewer than 30 rows or fewer than 10 selected rows
fewer than 30 rows or fewer than 10 selected rows

examples.note: Rows whose selection at the rule disagrees with the outcome, with the feature values as written in the file. Examples to read, not a sample.

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap over the out-of-fold predictions of the development rows

gain_points.definition: gain_points is the precision of the top share minus the base rate, in percentage points; recall is the share of the positive rows found (the cumulative gain).

prior_exposure.source: Results of an earlier analysis published with the dataset
prior_exposure.value: Outputs of an earlier analysis (protocol "stratified-70-30": Stratified random 70/30 split. 3164 training rows, 1357 validation rows, seed 20261017. Standardization and encoding fitted on training data only.) were published with this dataset. The rows used there are not unseen, and that validation is not independent evidence.
data/split.json records the tutorial split (seed 20261017) whose validation metrics were published with this dataset. A study that reuses this seed has no unseen validation rows.

notes: The logistic refit waits until feature availability is confirmed again.

impacts.change: a change that alters the set of usable features
notes: The constant baseline uses no feature and stays current.

impacts.change: a change of the variable descriptions that keeps the same usable features
notes: The feature set is unchanged; only the dictionary text changes.

impacts.change: a different split of the rows
notes: Exposure is retained: rows explored under the old split are not unseen. The split activity reports the overlap (exposure.overlap) when it runs.
No refit: predictions are reused. The previous policy confirmation is superseded.

impacts.change: a switch between a threshold rule and a capacity rule
a different preparation of the variables
notes: The constant baseline uses no feature and stays current; the exploration is unchanged.
No result changes; the conclusion is judged against the new criterion.
The baseline and the candidate stay current; only the variant is fitted again. The trial count grows by one configuration.
